S-01.claim: Erasing one bit costs at least kT ln2 of energy, released as heat.
S-01.journal: IBM Journal of Research and Development 5(3), 183-191
S-01.use: memory can be billed as work; the station runs on the waste heat

S-02.claim: Entanglement cannot carry a signal by itself.
S-02.use: the relay holds and schedules; it never transmits faster than light

S-03.claim: Information can be measured in bits; one bit is one bit whatever it means.
S-03.use: grams are a derived unit, not a mystical one

S-04.claim: A choice made after the fact stays consistent with a single history.
S-04.use: the release date cannot be overwritten by the network

S-05.claim: An unknown quantum state cannot be cloned.
S-05.use: contents are destroyed on transmission; only weight and signature survive

S-06.claim: Saat ukuran turun 10 kali, luas turun 100 kali dan volume turun 1.000 kali; kekuatan relatif terhadap berat naik.
S-06.sumber: Discorsi e dimostrazioni matematiche intorno a due nuove scienze (1638), Hari Kedua.
S-06.use: skala mengubah siapa yang berkuasa, bukan hukum fisika

S-07.claim: Lintasan nyata adalah lintasan yang membuat aksi stasioner; seluruh lintasan dapat ditinjau sekaligus.
S-07.sumber: Hamilton (1834), 'On a General Method in Dynamics', Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society 124, 247-308.
S-07.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society 124
S-07.use: tanggal rilis sebagai satu lintasan yang sudah utuh

S-08.claim: Ingatan yang dipanggil kembali menjadi labil dan harus disimpan ulang; ia bisa diubah sebelum disimpan.
S-08.use: ingatan bisa disunting tepat setelah diingat

S-09.claim: Tabrakan antarsatelit menghasilkan puing yang memicu tabrakan berikutnya; risiko tumbuh tak linear.
S-09.use: evakuasi berisiko karena jalur penuh puing
